answer_1.quote: We propose a novel LLM-based approach for simulating and evaluating professional narrative therapy. Specifically, we introduce the Interactive Narrative Therapist (INT) for simulation and the Innovative Moment Assessment (IMA) for tracking and evaluating therapeutic progression, both grounded in core psychotherapy principles.

answer_2.quote: We use standard metrics: BLEU-1/2, ROUGE-L, METEOR, and Extrema.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o to simulate a strict counseling supervisor to evaluate the resulting dialogues across all therapeutic dimensions and identified IMs in each client utterance following the theoretical protocol.

answer_4.quote: We conduct comprehensive evaluations via both automated assessment (with 260 simulated clients) and extensive human evaluation (involving 230 participants in the main (200) and follow-up (30) studies, plus expert annotators).
answer_4.guideline: Participants are asked to rate their experience on four dimensions using a 5-point Likert scale. Two qualitative researchers independently annotate sessions using explicit rules with all client identifiers removed.
